name: @somewhere-tech/cli
stderr:
Usage: somewhere [options] [command]

CLI for somewhere.tech

Options:
  -V, --version                                        output the version number
  -h, --help                                           display help for command

Commands:
  login [options]                                      Authenticate with somewhere.tech (no account yet? run `somewhere signup`)
  signup                                               Create a somewhere.tech account — opens the sign-up page and prints its URL
  logout                                               Revoke and remove stored credentials
  whoami [options]                                     Show current user info
  auth                                                 Manage stored credentials
  init [options]                                       Write a local starter; when signed in, also create a project and link this directory
  link                                                 Link this directory to an existing project (alias for `init --link`)
  project                                              Manage projects
  projects [options]                                   List all projects (create one with `somewhere init --bare --name <name>`)
  deploy [options] [dir]                               Deploy the current directory (anonymous automatically when logged out)
  pull [options] [project]                             Download a project's deployed source files to the current directory.
  typecheck [options] [dir]                            Check a source project with `tsc --noEmit`.
  lint [options] [dir]                                 Check Somewhere source contracts offline before deploy: credentials in source, schema declarations, directory index routes, request input choosing row ownership on server writes, and sw.email.send awaited inside a loop.
  hooks                                                Agent after-edit hooks: run the deploy's reference check after each file edit an agent makes
  promote [options] <preview_session_id> <preview_id>  Promote one exact preview to production.
  rollback [options] [project]                         Revert production to the previous deployed version.
  db                                                   Inspect managed production rows or run SQL against your raw database
  postgres                                             Attach your own Neon Postgres database to a project (sw.postgres)
  docs [options] [topic] [terms...]                    Read platform docs.
  advisor [options] [question]                         Ask the somewhere.tech platform advisor; local context is attached only with --file
  catalog [options] [tool]                             Browse the live somewhere.tech platform tool catalog; pass a tool for its input schema or a category such as email
  logs [options] [project]                             Show recent logs
  errors [options] [project]                           Show what recently went wrong in a project — the curated 24h view (endpoint, status, error, time).
  env                                                  Manage environment variables
  run [options] <script>                               Run a one-off script once against your project's production bindings and production data (sw.db / sw.fs / sw.ai / sw.search …) without deploying, and print its return value + console logs.
  status [options] [project]                           Show project and workspace status
  open [options] [project]                             Open the project URL in your browser
  dev [options]                                        Frontend hot reload with API requests proxied to your deployed project.
  preview [options]                                    Run your app on the platform instead of your machine.
  browser [options] [target]                           SEE, inspect, and DRIVE any web page and print the combined HEALTH SIGNAL — console errors, failed requests, JS page errors, and the interactive-element (DOM) map — as grep-able text, not a dumped image.
  verify [options] [target]
